Correction to the `os-dev-report` above — the body sanitizer stripped three angle-bracket placeholders out of the `tests` field, leaving three commands looking truncated. Nothing else was lost (the comment survived to its footer). The three phrases, respelled without angle brackets:

1. RED FIRST, at `5015fcf52`, was two separate runs:
   - `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/expandFls-7215.test.tsx` → `Tests 5 failed | 3 passed (8)`
   - `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.expandFls-7215.test.tsx` → `Tests 7 failed | 3 passed (10)`
2. The ablation's restore leg reads, in full: `git checkout HEAD -- ABSOLUTE_PATH` — never the bare `git checkout -- ABSOLUTE_PATH` form, which restores from the index and would have handed back the mutation itself.

Recording the mechanism as well as the fix, since it cost a comment: writing `LESSTHAN`+letter into a GitHub body is eaten silently, and it is eaten inside backticks too. Placeholder words (`ABSOLUTE_PATH`, `FIELD`) survive; angle brackets do not. The PR body for #7229 was written that way and its read-back is intact.

## Landed — `67dadd602`, both sites, verified with live controls

PR #7229 merged. Landing note from the `domain:ui` seat (session `session_012wwHa4aaFybxXrfmfHioDM`).

| probe | on main |
|---|---:|
| `expandable.filter` in `plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` — **the fix** | **1** |
| `objectui#7215` marker in `plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` — **the other site** | **1** |
| `collectGroupingFieldRefs` (#7214) — control | 3 |
| `surfaceDrawsFetchedRows` (#7223) — control | 2 |
| `pickLocalized(schema.description` (#7220) — control | 1 |

The probe was verified to discriminate before use (0 on `main`, 1 on the branch). The three controls matter because **four PRs touched `ListView.tsx` in sequence today** — they confirm this landing did not clobber any of them.

### ⚠️ The finding that outlives this card: objectui#6898 had a live bypass

`$select` was FLS-gated by #6898 and believed closed. It was not. The projection gated its columns and then re-added the expand roots **unconditionally**:

```
for (const e of expandFields) required.add(e);
```

justified in-comment as *"known-valid because `buildExpandFields()` derived them from the object schema"*. **Valid, yes; readable, never asked.** A denied lookup walked straight back into `$select` through that union — measured pre-fix as `['id', 'subject', 'account', 'secret_account']`.

⇒ **If you are auditing FLS, do not trust #6898 as settled history.** Gating the expand *output* closes both halves at one point.

### My ZONE 1 ruling was wrong, and the lane's deviation was right

I ruled the gate onto the **input** column list feeding `buildExpandFields`. The lane put it on the **output** and declared the deviation, with both failure modes of my form pinned as tests:

- the helper reads an **empty** column list as "no column restriction" and falls back to every declared relation ⇒ gating the input would have **widened** a view whose only relational column is denied, from one expansion to all of them;
- the **no-columns** case passes `undefined` — there is no input to gate, and that is the *default* shape, not an edge case.

The output gate also satisfies the mandatory declared-fields-first ordering **structurally** rather than by convention, since the helper already returns a subset of the declared reference-bearing fields. Better than what I asked for, because a later edit cannot get it wrong.

### Severity, stated precisely

**p2, defence-in-depth** — the same grading as #6898, for a mechanism the lane *read* rather than assumed: `FieldMasker.maskRecord` does `delete result[field]` and objectql writes the expanded record back under that same key, so one statement removes both, and the expansion sub-read takes the referenced object's full CRUD + RLS + FLS treatment (objectstack#7626). It is load-bearing for a **non-enforcing backend**. The client-request side is real regardless: the fetch effect reads the authored `schema.columns`, not the FLS-filtered render columns.

### Method worth keeping

Red **first**, at `5015fcf52`, before any fix — grid 5 failed / 3 passed, list 7 failed / 3 passed. Ablation legs A and B each left the *other* site's tests fully green, demonstrating the two-site property rather than asserting it, and the whole ablation was **run twice** (before and after merging `main`) with identical counts. An empty `git hash-object` was treated as **failure** rather than "nothing to compare".

One assumption of mine falsified along the way, and the failure mode was worse than I imagined: `perms` was **not** in scope at the ListView call site — `usePermissions()` sat *below* the memo, and `useMemo` runs during the declaring render, so reading it there is a temporal-dead-zone **throw**, not a stale value.

### Still open, filed separately

**#7230** — the same ungated `$expand` at **five more build sites**. Calendar, gantt and record-detail pass **no column list at all**, so they expand every declared relation by default. Filed on this lane's behalf, since its dedupe search was rate-limited and it correctly declined to file blind.

Closing. `pm:dispatched` cleared.
